t: How to Shop for Rare Vinyl Records That Could Be Worth Serious Money
s: December 10, 2024 - Shopping for records on eBay and Amazon will only get you so far, and finding truly rare vinyl requires a deeper dive into online record culture. Search for record groups on social media platforms like Facebook and Reddit. You’ll be able to quickly connect with other collectors who share your excitement and passion for vinyl, says Matthew Coats, owner of Big Dawg Records. There, you can engage with other people who are looking to buy, sell, and trade, often at surprisingly reasonable prices.
